context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11 site features verified. The site now has all 3 configurable colors (button, background, container). Submissions show file attachments with thumbnails. Badge count appears in sidebar and clears after viewing. Speaker icon changes to orange on hover.

1. Submissions view shows file_urls as t.details: Bijlagen section shows thumbnails for images (sample.jpg) and links with icons for audio files (audio.mp3)

2. Speaker/volume icon hover changes to.details: Initial color: rgb(161, 161, 170) -> Hover color: rgb(249, 115, 22) (matches #f97316) -> Returns to initial on mouse leave

3. Site dashboard Form tab has 3 color p.details: Found: Knop kleur (#f97316), Achtergrond kleur (#09090b), Kader kleur (#18181b)

4. Color preview shows all 3 colors toge.details: 'Voorbeeld kleuren' section shows container preview with 'Kader voorbeeld' text and 'Verstuur' button

5. Submissions tab in sidebar shows badg.details: Badge shows count '1' in orange background next to 'Inzendingen' in sidebar

6. Badge disappears after viewing submis.details: POST /api/sites/{site_id}/submissions/mark-viewed returns success, subsequent count returns 0

8. Public page applies container_color t.details: Audio container and form container both show rgb(24, 24, 27) matching #18181b

9. Public page form shows file upload se.details: 'Bestanden toevoegen' section with 'Afbeelding, audio of video uploaden' button visible

10. GET /api/sites/{site_id}/submissions.details: Endpoint returns {"count": N} where N is number of unviewed submissions

11. POST /api/sites/{site_id}/submission.details: Endpoint returns {"message": "Marked as viewed"} and subsequent count returns 0
